# CreditDecide

> CreditDecide is the AI-native underwriting operating system for consumer lenders — personal loans, instalment lending and point-of-sale finance. Seven solutions in one platform, covering borrower intake through explainable decision, with full evidence lineage and governed AI-assistant access. No code. Any country, any currency.

CreditDecide helps consumer lending teams automate application intake, analyze borrower documents, assess affordability, apply configurable underwriting policies, assess credit risk, and produce explainable lending decisions — without writing code. Connect AI exposes the platform to compatible AI assistants over the Model Context Protocol, so lenders can retrieve authorized data and explore evidence within governed controls.

## Solutions — Four ways in

- [AI Underwriter](https://creditdecide.com/features/ai-underwriting): Your best credit officer's judgment, on every file. Reads borrower documents, normalizes financial and credit data, evaluates your lending policy, and produces a recommendation with a probability of default and confidence score — in minutes.
- [AI Credit Officer](https://creditdecide.com/features/ai-credit-officer): Chases the paperwork so your team doesn't. Spots what's missing, opens structured information requests in the borrower's portal, and re-runs underwriting the moment a document lands.
- [Risk Score](https://creditdecide.com/features/risk-assessment): A credit signal where the bureau has none. Five risk dimensions — credit, affordability, fraud, data quality, policy — each with severity, direction, and a human-readable explanation.
- [Document Capture](https://creditdecide.com/features/document-intelligence): Reads the documents other tools reject. Classifies uploaded documents, extracts fields with confidence scores, and links every value back to its source for full provenance.

## Solutions — The whole platform

- [Intelligent LOS](https://creditdecide.com/features/intelligent-los): Every product in one system. Personal loans, instalment, point-of-sale, and auto on a single application model, policy engine, evidence graph, and audit trail.
- [AI Loan Application](https://creditdecide.com/features/ai-loan-application): Catches missing documents as they are uploaded. AI-native forms classify and validate every upload in real time, so incomplete applications rarely reach your team.
- [AI Borrower Portal](https://creditdecide.com/features/borrower-portal): Every borrower, always in the loop. A single branded link for status, to-dos, document uploads, and a 24/7 assistant with human handoff.

## Platform controls

- [Credit Decisioning](https://creditdecide.com/features/credit-decisioning): Explainable APPROVE / REVIEW / DECLINE outcomes backed by the policy rules that fired and the evidence that supported them.
- [Lending Policies](https://creditdecide.com/features/lending-policies): A visual, no-code policy builder with versioned, never-overwrite policies and simulation before activation.
- [Explainable Decisions](https://creditdecide.com/features/explainable-decisions): Every risk signal traces through an evidence graph to its source field — auditable by construction.
- [Connect AI (MCP)](https://creditdecide.com/connect): Bring underwriting into Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor and more, scoped to your organization's data and policies.

## Markets

CreditDecide is built for consumer lenders in any market worldwide. Primary markets: United Kingdom, United States, Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya, Ghana, and Others — with configurable policies, KYC, currencies, and data sources per market.

## Key facts

- No-code: visual policy builder, white-label intake forms, no integration required.
- Explainable: evidence graph from every signal to its source field; decisions exportable as PDF, CSV, and Word.
- Governed AI: the AI underwriter advises; your versioned policy engine decides. Connect AI runs org-scoped, audited, with confirmation on decision-changing actions.
- End-to-end: intake → document intelligence → normalization → risk assessment → policy evaluation → decision → monitoring → collections.
- Multi-environment: sandbox and production isolation.
